title: ContractBreachRecord
description: Standardized Dead-Letter Queue envelope for malformed or contract-breaching event payloads diverted to eios.l1.dlq.v1.

dlq_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying this dead-letter queue record.

event_id.description: Originating event identifier from incoming metadata, or generated surrogate if missing.

product_name.description: Target Layer 1 data product contract that rejected the payload.

breach_timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp when the contract breach was intercepted.

breach_type.description: Categorical typology of the validation failure.

error_messages.description: Detailed validation diagnostic messages produced by Pydantic / contract validator.

raw_payload_bytes.description: Verbatim raw byte payload preserved for zero-loss compliance and downstream replay.

source_topic.description: Ingestion channel or Pub/Sub topic where message was received.

ingestion_metadata.description: Optional transport headers, client IP, or correlation IDs.
